name: pushpin
description: Thumbtack's Pushpin design system as an invokable skill. Ships the token stylesheet generated from the Pushpin Thumbprint UI Kit Figma file — colors in light and dark, a responsive type ramp, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion — plus a catalog of every published Figma component, the full 227-icon set with its size ramp, Thumbtack's content design rules and the checks that hold a screen's words to them, the Annotation Kit for arguing a proposed component on canvas, and a verified path for generating Figma layouts from real library instances.
